purpose: Checked dependency lock for the standalone Python-free native build (task T03). .deps/ is populated only by explicit acquisition before configure; configure, build and install make no network calls and run no dependency code-generation Python. Every entry records the real verified SHA-256 of the acquired archive plus the consumed files, the license, and the exact version/commit identity.

mujoco.purpose: Physics engine SDK: C headers plus the shared library pinned for the private TLS error-handler ABI (_mjPRIVATE_setTlsLogHandler / _mjPRIVATE_getGlobalLogHandler / mj_makeRawData).

acquisition.pin_source: uv.lock mujoco==3.12.0 cp314 macosx_11_0_arm64 wheel hash (verified identical to the downloaded artifact and to the installed .venv copy: libmujoco.3.12.0.dylib sha256 9e7724614fb0b3f346758ff4158ef65e7c398f2caa3e9daab41ed210b4ab689c matches the wheel-extracted dylib byte for byte)
acquisition.note: The wheel is only the transport for the already-pinned MuJoCo binaries; no Python interpreter, package or wheel directory enters the build closure.

duckdb.purpose: DuckDB C API SDK (headers + shared library) for the native recording/replay publication path; pinned to match the input snapshot's duckdb==1.5.6.

acquisition.pin_source: GitHub release tag v1.5.6 'DuckDB v1.5.6 Bugfix Release'; embedded DUCKDB_SOURCE_ID 069cc9f9b5 and DUCKDB_VERSION v1.5.6 in duckdb.hpp
acquisition.note: The PyPI duckdb wheel statically links the engine into _duckdb.so and ships no C SDK, so the native SDK comes from the upstream release; its embedded version macros identify the artifact.

tomlplusplus.purpose: Header-only TOML parser for configuration/request/track file loading (T13+).

rapidjson.purpose: Header-only JSON SAX/DOM parser; kParseNumbersAsStringsFlag exposes exact number lexemes for the lossless codec boundary (T05).

acquisition.pin_source: Tencent/rapidjson master commit 24b5e7a8b27f42fa16b96fc70aade9106cf7102f (2025-02-05), the upstream commit pinned for this migration

glfw.purpose: Window/context/event layer for the MuJoCo passive-viewer GUI path (T48+); its upstream build is CMake-native (no Python).

cairo.purpose: Pinned native raster backend for PNG plot output (T50). Upstream build tooling (meson) needs Python, so the qualified workflow consumes a verified binary SDK rather than an upstream source build; the source archive is locked here for provenance and header access pending SDK acquisition (T50/T59).

eigen.purpose: Header-only dense linear algebra (decompositions) for the bounded least-squares, allocation and rider-dynamics solver ports (T23/T28/T29); native math support locked at T03.
